summary: Forward-thinking professional with various experience in human resources, sales, customer service and education, offering excellent communication and computer skills; highly organized and meticulous.

experience.title: HR Contact Center Specialist
responsibilities: Answer and resolve employee and people‑manager issues, including navigational support and corrective transactions.
Provide guidance on HR processes such as year‑end compensation, resource planning, and employee data changes.
Administer employee programs (service recognition, PTO/Vacation entitlement, time administration).
Maintain audit, compliance, and regulatory requirements.
Support HR policies, benefits, payroll, and employee programs across HR systems.
Participate in new hire training, women in leadership initiatives, and quality improvement projects.

experience.title: Admissions Representative
responsibilities: Conduct face‑to‑face, telephone, and email interviews to identify student prospects.
Mentor students through the admissions process.
Ensure compliance with company policies, laws, and regulations.
Participate in retention efforts and maintain contact with active students.

experience.title: Recruiting Coordinator
responsibilities: Maintain assessment database and coordinate job fairs.
On‑site interview coordination, e‑verify processing, and payroll data entry.
Update payroll records, resolve discrepancies, and compile interview packages.
Perform background checks and manage front‑desk operations.

experience.title: Branch Coordinator
responsibilities: Maintain filing systems and manage front‑desk operations.
Answer and screen incoming calls, schedule orientations, and track applicant flow.
Perform weekly data entry of applications and manage office traffic.
